messages:
elaine-docs: Heads-up  I'm working on a small docs patch covering geo fallbacks and how SDKs expose residency. Need quick sanity check on wording and the legal footnote.

tim-ops: drop the draft snippet here and i'll verify headers/behaviour.

elaine-docs: Draft snippet (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n   -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n   -H 'X-Redwood-Region: ap-southeast-1' \n   -d '{"model":"gpt-xx","locale":"fr-CA"}'
```
Short note: "If the requested region/model combo can't serve the locale, Redwood will route to a compatible region variant and include the actual region in the response header `X-Redwood-Routed-Region`. Users can opt into strict residency to force an error instead."

tim-ops: mostly right. precision: we never rewrite the client URL or return HTTP redirects for internal routing. We set `X-Redwood-Routed-Region` and `X-Redwood-Routing-Mode: best-effort` (or `strict`) on the response. If strict residency is requested and unavailable we return 409 with body guidance.

elaine-docs: good thanks. i'll update language to avoid "redirect" word. planning to add two SDK examples: one for pre-v1 JS style (residency.strict header) and one for the new config object in v1+.

nina-privacy: please include the standard short legal blurb: "Requests routed outside the requested residency may be processed outside the requested region unless strict residency is enabled." Keep it as a footnote. Also add link to compliance page for enterprise customers.

elaine-docs: done. i'll point to /docs/compliance/residency and /internal/routing-policies for more details.

tim-ops: tiny nit: mention the response header key EXACTLY: `X-Redwood-Routed-Region: eu-west-2` example. and add an example 409 body for strict.

elaine-docs: added both. sample 409 body: { "error": "residency_unavailable", "message": "Requested strict residency not available for model in region." }

infra-bot: CI: markdownlint OK, linkcheck warnings for /internal/* links marked as internal-only.

nina-privacy: +1 from privacy (footnote wording good).

tim-ops: +1 from ops. i left a small comment about wording near the headers paragraph.

elaine-docs: thanks all. will merge after CI green and a quick +1 from eng-docs reviewer. ETA EOD. :sparkles:
